description: This Java class models an immutable representation of a configuration field, including parsing, size calculation, and code generation for TunerStudio and Java fields.

classes.name: ConfigField
classes.description: Represents an immutable configuration field with parsing, size calculation, and code generation methods.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a line of text into a ConfigField object using regex matching.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the current field, considering bit fields and array size.

methods.name: getHeaderText
methods.description: Generates C header text for the field, including comments and array notation.

methods.name: writeTunerStudio
methods.description: Writes TunerStudio configuration entries for the field, updating position offset.

methods.name: writeJavaFields
methods.description: Generates Java code for the field, including enum options and field definitions.

methods.name: getCommentContent
methods.description: Returns the comment content, stripping comment tags if present.
